scope: All critical and high severity weaknesses from the 2026-07-24 whole-project review.

decisionsLocked.ferpa: Fail closed for uploads only — resume upload/assist and staff_entered hard-gate to the local provider (503 when unavailable); chat may use cloud with consent + audit. Rewrite CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/sage-ai.md to describe exactly this split. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.kpi: Relabel the funnel step to 'Active BHAG' AND add two aggregate measures: percent with a confirmed BHAG reviewed within 14 days, and percent with a pathway linked to a confirmed goal. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.registry: Generate the endpoint registry from the src/app/api route tree with a CI parity check that fails on drift, modeled on the catalog overlay-freshness test. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.trackers: Unify application tracking on the Application model (it already carries verificationStatus/verifiedBy/verifiedAt and is read by four teacher surfaces). Migrate StudentSavedJob into it and bridge applied/interviewing/offer to a teacher signal that records the SPOKES employment outcome. StudentSavedJob does NOT gain verification fields — it stops being the pipeline. Owner, 2026-07-24.

findings.title: Crisis scan and staff alert run only after a fully successful model stream
findings.fix: Run detectCrisisSignal on the user message and fire recordWellbeingConcern immediately after the message is saved, before provider resolution. Keep the reply-side 988 block where it is.
findings.notes: Extracted the scan into src/lib/chat/crisis-alert.ts (one shared, never-throwing helper) and called it before provider resolution and before all three direct-answer early returns. post-response.ts now calls the same helper as a backstop, and its false header claim that a provider outage 'can never suppress' the scan was corrected.

findings.title: FERPA local-only routing fails open to cloud
findings.fix: Apply the locked FERPA decision: hard-gate student_record/staff_entered on the upload paths to local (503 when unavailable); allow chat on cloud with consent + audit; rewrite the two docs to describe the split.
findings.notes: Two-tier routing: DOCUMENT_LOCAL_ONLY_TASKS hard-gate to local and throw when unconfigured; chat keeps the configured provider. Gated by task, not sensitivity, because sage_staff_chat carries staff_entered and a sensitivity gate would have taken staff chat offline. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/rules/sage-ai.md rewritten to describe the real split.

findings.title: Resume PII flows to Gemini cloud by default
findings.fix: Covered by the FERPA decision: resume upload and assist are the hard-gated paths. Return 503 when no local provider is available rather than falling through to cloud.
findings.notes: Covered by the same gate: resume_extract and resume_assist are in DOCUMENT_LOCAL_ONLY_TASKS, and both routes already audited as blocked and returned 503 on a throw, so no route change was needed. tailor_application added too (it generates from stored resume text); its errors are genericized by executeAndLedger so the operator-facing message never reaches a student.

findings.title: Crisis detector misses the informal phrasings this population types
findings.fix: Add contraction/slang alternations (wanna die, dont wanna be here, unalive, kms, gonna od) and method-adjacent phrases; grow the unit-test corpus; add at least one informal red-team case.
findings.notes: 11 new pattern entries covering contractions (wanna/gonna/needa), euphemism (unalive), abbreviations (kms/ksy), 'ending things', passive 'better off if I wasnt here', and method-adjacent disclosure (od/overdose, took all my pills). 31-case test pins 20 must-detect phrases AND 11 false-positive guards ('wanna die my hair', 'took my medication this morning') so recall gains do not turn the alert stream into noise. New gating red-team case crisis-informal-contraction; it asserts the 988 block, which is appended deterministically by the detector, so it cannot flake on model wording.

findings.title: Students can self-complete Sage-proposed goals
findings.fix: Restrict student transitions on sourceMessageId goals to dismissal until confirmed; render the proposal badge and disable the checkbox at every level; add route tests for proposed to completed.
findings.notes: Extracted isAwaitingInstructorConfirmation into src/lib/goals.ts as the single definition, used by both the PATCH guard (server authority) and the UI, so the interface can never offer an action the API rejects. API: student status transitions on an unconfirmed Sage proposal are 403 except 'abandoned' (dismissal stays available) and 'confirmed' (the pre-existing, more specific guard owns that message). Content edits still allowed. Discovered the route's select omitted confirmedAt, which would have made the guard misfire. UI: GoalRecord was missing sourceMessageId/confirmedAt entirely (the server already sent them via include), so the client could not distinguish a suggestion from the student's own goal; now declared, checkboxes disabled with an aria-label at weekly and task level, an 'Awaiting instructor' badge added where none existed, and a guard at the single handleToggleGoalStatus choke point covering all five call sites.

findings.title: GET /api/progression mints XP, so attendance streaks measure page loads
findings.fix: Make the GET read-only; move the daily check-in award to an explicit POST behind a real action (mood check-in). Pass one fetched readiness result down instead of re-fetching.
findings.notes: GET /api/progression is now XP-neutral: the daily_checkin award (+15 XP + streak day) moved to POST /api/mood, a deliberate once-a-day act, keyed on the day so a second check-in is a no-op via awardEvent's unique constraint, and wrapped so a progression failure cannot lose the mood entry or its wellbeing alert. Also collapsed the route's read-write-read into a single readiness fetch. Deliberate deviation from the stated fix: the zero-XP readiness-achievement reconciliation STAYS in the GET, because this route is its only trigger anywhere in the codebase — removing it would have meant readiness achievements were never granted at all. It awards no XP and never touches a streak.

findings.title: Goals-page Ask Sage injects fabricated messages into the real conversation
findings.fix: Route scaffolding calls through a non-persisting endpoint, or tag them as system-initiated and render them as such in the transcript.
findings.notes: New ephemeral POST /api/sage/scaffold: streams a reply, persists no message, opens no conversation, triggers no extraction, awards no XP — but still records the AI audit event, because not persisting the turn must not mean losing the data-path trail. Takes goalId instead of prompt text so the browser cannot choose the words sent to the model, and the goal lookup is scoped by studentId. Tests use tripwire mocks on saveMessage/handlePostResponse/awardEvent so a future regression that reintroduces persistence fails loudly. Also fixed the SSE client bug the review flagged: the parser decoded each chunk standalone without stream:true and without carrying a partial line, so any data: frame split across a network boundary was silently dropped.

findings.title: Goal hierarchy mis-wired: goals counted in progress but never rendered
findings.fix: Extract a pure buildGoalTree module with unit tests and make the renderer total (every active goal renders exactly once); enforce the level lattice at write time.
findings.notes: New pure src/lib/goal-tree.ts (buildGoalTree forest + buildGoalsPageModel + flattenGoalRows + isValidGoalParentLevel). Ownership cuts at monthly/bhag boundaries; missing parents and cycles degrade to visible orphan rows. Totality pinned by hand-built pathologies (depth-4 task, direct monthly task, weekly-under-bhag, dangling parent, 2-cycle) AND a 40-iteration seeded hostile random-forest sweep asserting every goal renders exactly once. Renderer swaps its seven filter passes for the model: monthly cards render+count identical row sets (the always-empty mDirectTasks bug and depth-3 drops are gone), weekly sub-rows include all depths, and the orphan card renders every orphan with indentation instead of filtering to weekly-or-parentless. POST /api/goals now rejects mis-leveled nesting (lattice: bhag→monthly→weekly→daily→task, tasks/dailies also directly under monthly); PATCH does not accept parentId/level changes so no guard was needed there.

findings.title: Read-tier lookup_cert_progress mutates: creates cert rows and awards XP
findings.fix: Split the ensure-or-create path out so the lookup returns not-started; put creation behind an explicit start action. Add a test asserting no read-tier tool writes.
findings.notes: lookup_cert_progress now calls new read-only getStudentCertProgress: no create, no cert_started XP, no status recompute — this also stops the nightly headless briefing (which allowlists the tool) from silently starting certifications across students. Never-started students get a not_started view keyed by TEMPLATE ids; markRequirementComplete (the explicit start action, consequential tier, confirmation-carded) accepts a template id, runs ensureStudentCertification, and resolves the freshly created requirement — so the model's lookup-then-mark flow is unchanged and no tool schema changed. Tripwire tests assert the read performs zero writes; bridge tests cover start-on-mark and nonsense-id rejection.

findings.title: Parallel tool calls cross-wire results into the wrong response
findings.fix: Key transcript records by callId and look up the matching record per tool_result event; add a two-parallel-call attribution test.
findings.notes: ToolCallHandler now carries the provider-minted callId; both providers (gemini-provider.ts, ollama-provider.ts) pass it, the loop threads it into executeAgentTool (which already accepted options.callId), and the tool_result branch looks up transcript.find by event.callId instead of taking the last record. Attribution test forces reversed completion order (second call resolves first) so the old last-record lookup demonstrably cross-wires; also asserts the executor received the provider callIds. headless.ts and llm-usage.ts forward the handler verbatim and needed no change.

findings.title: Agent goal writes skip XP, progression and cache invalidation
findings.fix: Extract the goal-status transition (update + progression + XP + cache invalidation) into one lib helper called by both the route and the tool; audit remaining write tools for the same drift.
findings.notes: New src/lib/goal-status.ts: applyGoalStatusEffects (cache invalidation + ensureGoalLevelProgression for plan-counting statuses + BHAG-completion XP) shared by PATCH /api/goals/[id] and the update_goal_status tool, which now calls transitionGoalStatus instead of a bare prisma.goal.update. Write-tool drift audit: save_job also writes outside its HTTP route's effect set — deliberately deferred to VQ-R-017, which replaces the StudentSavedJob pipeline entirely (cross-referenced there); the other write tools (submit_form via applyStudentOrientationCompletion, mark_certification_complete via cert-actions, book_appointment, update_application_status) already share their route-side helpers.

findings.title: Consequential rate limit double-counts; the block lands after confirm
findings.fix: Do not consume a mutate-tier unit for the proposal leg (or refund it); check-without-consume at confirm time so an approved card never fails on quota alone.
findings.notes: Interpretation recorded (the prescription's two clauses conflict if read literally — no leg would ever consume): the PROPOSAL leg peeks (new peekRateLimit store read + peekToolRateLimit wrapper, no consumption) and may block; the CONFIRMED leg never blocks on quota — an approved HMAC card always runs — and consumes exactly one unit after the tool executes successfully (not on tool error). Net effect: one action = one unit, and the block can only ever land before the student is asked to confirm. Read/reversible tiers keep the original single-leg consume. Five existing test mocks of ./rate-limit gained the new export.

findings.title: Read-auditing wired into 1 of ~13 student-data GETs
findings.fix: Fold recordStudentView into the shared assertStaffCanManageStudent path so read-auditing is automatic for every student-data GET; wire the missing surfaces; delete unused StudentViewSurface values.
findings.notes: recordStudentView now fires inside assertStaffCanManageStudent itself — the gate all ~46 teacher-facing call sites already pass — with default surface "student_data", caller override (student-detail route passes "student_detail" and dropped its now-duplicate direct call), and an explicit null opt-out for flows audited more precisely elsewhere. Denied access never audits; auditing is fire-and-forget and can never block access. Mutations passing the gate also log a sampled view — accepted noise, bounded by the existing 1/(actor,student,surface)/day sampling. Unused surface values "conversations"/"export" deleted; "student_data" added.

findings.title: CSV formula injection: two of four export paths bypass the safe escaper
findings.fix: Delete csvEscape and route the forms-response and coordinator monthly exports through escapeCsvValue; add a fixture proving = + - @ prefixes are neutralized.
findings.notes: csvEscape deleted from forms/export.ts; new csvCell wrapper in src/lib/csv.ts coerces unknown cells (null → empty, arrays → semicolon-joined) then applies the formula-safe escapeCsvValue, so all four export paths share one escaper. Forms export rows and the coordinator monthly report both route through it. Fixture pins = + - @ neutralization including a formula hidden behind quote-triggering characters.

findings.title: Default browse pool serves senior big-tech roles to TANF/SNAP students
findings.fix: Remove the hardcoded elite-tech boards from BROWSE_SOURCES (keep opt-in per class if wanted) and add a seniority heuristic on title tokens to job-quality or scoring.

findings.title: Save button silently fails for every browse job and unenrolled student
findings.fix: Covered by the tracker decision: saving a browse row creates an Application. Also surface non-OK save responses to the user instead of ignoring them.

findings.title: Two parallel application trackers, neither reaching the employment outcome
findings.fix: Apply the locked tracker decision: unify on Application, migrate StudentSavedJob, and bridge applied/interviewing/offer to a teacher signal that records the SPOKES employment outcome.

findings.title: Globally unique sourceId lets one class's scrape overwrite another's rows
findings.fix: Make the unique key compound on (classConfigId, sourceId) and key the upsert on it; add a two-configuration overlap test (scrape-engine has no test file today).
findings.notes: Migration 20260727120000_job_listing_source_id_per_class drops the global JobListing_sourceId_key and creates the compound unique — strictly weaker, so existing rows all satisfy it (no data change, safe deploy). Upsert extracted into exported upsertScrapedJob keyed on classConfigId_sourceId; scrape-engine gains its first test file, pinning that two classes scraping the same sourceId address distinct rows and that the update payload can never rewrite an existing row's owning class.

findings.title: Three of four default adapters have no fetch timeout
findings.fix: Route adzuna, usajobs and jsearch through fetchJson (or add AbortSignal.timeout); wrap the per-config loop so one class's failure does not abort the rest.

findings.title: Forms delivery degrades invisibly and can serve the wrong document
findings.fix: Log a warning with storageKey and fallback tier every time a bundled or content-dir fallback serves a request in production; add a Sentry breadcrumb; restrict the fuzzy content-dir scan to dev builds.
findings.notes: warnDegradedDelivery logs {storageKey, tier, matched} via the shared logger on every bundled / content-dir / fuzzy serve and adds a Sentry breadcrumb (Sentry imported lazily so the standalone asset-staging script's import of this module never pulls it in). The pass-2 fuzzy substring match is gated behind allowFuzzy (defaults to IS_DEV) — production returns null instead of risking the wrong document. findInContentDir gained baseDir/allowFuzzy options and an export for temp-dir fixture tests, which pin the normalized-collision case (spaces-vs-hyphens filename) both ways.

findings.title: Zero security scanning in CI for a FERPA-sensitive app
findings.fix: Add a dependency audit at high severity, a secret-scanning step, and a dependency-update config for the npm and github-actions ecosystems.
findings.notes: New parallel `security` CI job (verify's wall-clock unchanged): npm audit gating at high+ (verified clean today, so the gate lands green) and gitleaks full-history secret scanning (fetch-depth 0). Dependabot covers npm and github-actions weekly with grouped minor/patch to keep PR volume proportionate for a solo maintainer; security advisories bypass the schedule.

findings.title: 223 test files, zero coverage measurement
findings.fix: Add a test:coverage script around the existing runner, publish the summary in CI, and set the initial threshold at today's real number as a ratchet.
findings.notes: Measured today with node:test's built-in coverage through the existing tsx runner (no new dependency): 81.5% lines / 82.8% branches / 83.8% functions. test:coverage wraps the same glob with --experimental-test-coverage and a --test-coverage-lines=80 floor — just under the measured number so ordinary churn doesn't flake, but coverage can never silently sink below where it stood when first measured. CI's test step now runs the coverage variant, so one full-suite run gates failures and the ratchet together and prints the per-file table in the log.

findings.title: E2E and a11y suites run in no workflow; the deepest spec cannot run in CI
findings.fix: Add a CI job that migrates the existing Postgres service container, seeds, builds and runs playwright; switch the orientation spec to read process.env.DATABASE_URL with .env.local as a local fallback.
findings.notes: e2e + a11y steps added to the verify job AFTER build/smoke, reusing the already-migrated hermetic Postgres service: seed (db:seed against the service), npx playwright install chromium --with-deps, then npm run test:e2e with the service DATABASE_URL, a CI JWT secret, and BASE_URL/PORT 3100 (Playwright's webServer boots the app itself; reuseExistingServer is already CI-aware). The orientation spec resolves DATABASE_URL from the environment first with .env.local as the local fallback — it previously threw anywhere without that file, which is why the deepest spec could never run in CI. Deliberately continue-on-error until proven stable: PROMOTION RULE recorded here — remove continue-on-error after two consecutive green runs on main.

findings.title: Client-side Sentry is likely dead under the Turbopack build
findings.fix: Create src/instrumentation-client.ts with the current client init plus onRouterTransitionStart, export onRequestError from instrumentation.ts, and confirm a browser error actually arrives.
findings.notes: Client init moved verbatim (same DSN gate, sample rates, scrubPii) from the never-bundled root sentry.client.config.ts into src/instrumentation-client.ts — the only location Turbopack builds load — plus the onRouterTransitionStart export; instrumentation.ts exports onRequestError = Sentry.captureRequestError for RSC request errors; the dead root file is deleted and a static test pins all three so a rename can't silently kill client tracking again. OWNER ACTION post-deploy: trigger one browser error and confirm it arrives in Sentry (recorded here, not a deferral).

findings.title: browse-refresh cron was never scheduled; the code comment claiming it is false
findings.fix: Schedule a browse-refresh pg_cron job mirroring the daily-coaching pattern, or descope the browse pool explicitly and delete the endpoint plus script. Either way the false comment goes.
findings.notes: Scheduled (not descoped — the browse pool UI is live). Migration clones the guarded pg_cron+pg_net pattern from add_sage_briefing_cron: cron.schedule upsert by jobname, vault CRON_SECRET, graceful degradation without extensions or privileges. Slot 09:30 UTC (5:30 AM ET), offset from the 06:xx sage jobs, 11:00 briefing, and 13:00 daily-coaching. Script header rewritten to reference the real job. OWNER ACTION at deploy: confirm prod Supabase has app.base_url set and vault CRON_SECRET, and that 09:30 UTC suits the program day.

findings.title: The 2,217-line endpoint registry is 92% unenforced and two months stale
findings.fix: Apply the locked registry decision: generate the registry from the src/app/api route tree with a CI parity check that fails on drift. Delete the never-read rateLimit/tokenBudget fields and dead helpers.
findings.notes: Implementation nuance within the locked decision: descriptions/roles/audit levels can't be derived statically, so the GENERATED artifact is the route inventory (config/endpoint-inventory.generated.json — 185 routes, 13 wired, shared walker in scripts/lib/endpoint-inventory.mjs, deterministic output) and the parity test enforces correspondence three ways: committed inventory === live tree (drift fails CI with the regenerate command), every wired withRegistry id exists in the registry, and every enabled registry endpoint points at a real route+method. That last check caught and fixed 45 stale Express-style ':id' paths on first run — after normalization all 189 hand-authored entries correspond to real routes. Never-read rateLimit/tokenBudget fields deleted from types + all entries; dead getAiTools helper deleted. The test runs inside npm test, so it gates CI with no new workflow step.

findings.title: Charter lapsed 33 days with its outcome loop provably dead
findings.fix: Draft the successor 90-day window in docs/PRODUCT_GUIDE.md with dates, single accountable owners, and measurable outcomes (the handoff employment arc plus the maturity deferred list are most of the draft). Closing the GitHub milestones and issues #37-#40 is an owner action outside this branch.
findings.notes: DRAFT successor window (proposed 2026-08-04 → 2026-10-30) appended to PRODUCT_GUIDE.md and cross-linked from the status header, sourced from the maturity deferred list, the employment-workflow handoff, and the whole-project review's focus items. Theme: one clear path to employment, measured — no new surfaces. Five outcomes all measurable with instruments that now exist (goalIntegrity aggregates, queue instrumentation to be built this window, verified-outcome reporting, backfill/retention operational acts, corpus triage). Owners default to Project Owner / Instructor per the charter's own rule; every date, owner, and target carries OWNER-CONFIRM. Ratification + closing milestones #1/#2 and issues #37-#40 remain owner actions outside the branch.

findings.title: The mandated reading path delivers misinformation
findings.fix: Give every routed doc a status header (current / superseded-by / archived), delete or repoint the dead content/_INDEX.md row, archive or rewrite the March roadmap, and fix DEPLOY.md's cron topology.
findings.notes: The dead content/_INDEX.md row in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md now routes to the real SPOKES knowledge locations (catalog/index.md OKF layer + src/lib/spokes.ts staff record). DEPLOY.md's four Render-cron claims corrected to the actual Supabase pg_cron topology with the runbook cross-reference and cron.job_run_details verification queries. Status headers added to every routed doc that lacked one: the March roadmap (archived reference, PRODUCT_DECISIONS wins on conflict), the two shipped superpowers plans (historical), supabase-optimization (current, Phase 1 executed), funding options and the tunnel doc (current references), and DEPLOY.md itself.

findings.title: Headline outcomes unmeasurable; KPI funnel overstates Confirmed BHAG
findings.fix: Apply the locked KPI decision: relabel the funnel step to Active BHAG and add the two aggregate measures (confirmed BHAG reviewed within 14 days percent, pathway-linked-to-confirmed percent).
findings.notes: Code half (commit 98127b9): funnel step relabeled Active BHAG (it counts existence); new goalIntegrity aggregates report percent with a confirmed BHAG reviewed within 14 days and percent with a pathway linked to a confirmed goal, computed against the report's `now` for determinism; KPI route selects the three needed Goal fields. Doc half: the draft successor window in PRODUCT_GUIDE.md adopts the aggregates as its goal-integrity outcome with OWNER-CONFIRM targets, replacing the old unmeasurable headline claims going forward.
